_comment: Single source of truth for the valid `<dest>.<key>` config tokens the daemon (daemon/config.cpp's ApplyKey/Parse*String helpers) accepts, and the paper tokens daemon/paper_size.h's IsKnownPaper recognizes. Do not add a token here that the daemon doesn't actually parse -- scripts/gen-option-sets.py regenerates gui/BrscanConfigCore's Swift constants from this file, and tests/option_sets_test.cpp asserts the daemon itself accepts every token below (anti-drift guard in both directions). No real device identity belongs in this file.

source._comment: <dest>.source -- daemon/config.cpp's ParseSourceString(). adf-duplex sets Source::kAdf with duplex=true.

format._comment: <dest>.format -- daemon/config.cpp's ParseFormatString(), daemon/output_writer.h's OutputFormat. Default when unset is native.

tiff_compression._comment: <dest>.tiff_compression -- daemon/config.cpp's ParseTiffCompressionString(), daemon/output_writer.h's TiffCompression. Only affects tiff format; default is lzw.

ocr_format._comment: ocr.ocr_format -- daemon/config.cpp's ParseOcrFormatString(). OCR-only (honored solely under the `ocr` dest prefix): the OCR route's output sub-format. pdf -> the searchable PDF OCR has always produced; txt/html/rtf -> the recognized-text sinks. Distinct vocabulary from `format` above (OCR can't produce an image format). Default when unset is pdf.

separation_mode._comment: <dest>.separation -- daemon/config.cpp's ParseSeparationString(). These are the *modes*, not full tokens: combine/off take no suffix; image and page each take a ':N' positive-int suffix (e.g. 'image:3', 'page:2'). 'every:N' is also accepted as a backward-compat alias for 'image:N' (same mode, different spelling) -- not a separate mode. Default is combine.
separation_mode.n_rule: For 'image' and 'page', the full config value is '<mode>:N' where N is a positive integer (N >= 1). 'every:N' is a pre-existing alias for 'image:N'.

paper._comment: <dest>.paper -- daemon/paper_size.h's IsKnownPaper()/kPaperTable (daemon/paper_size.cpp). Exact, case-sensitive match; the daemon stores an unrecognized token as-is without validation, so this list is the GUI's own gate, not something the daemon itself enforces at config-parse time.

dpi._comment: <dest>.dpi -- daemon/config.cpp's ParsePositiveInt() applied to both x_dpi and y_dpi. Not an enumerated set: any positive integer is accepted by the parser. Default is 300 (brscan::Params's own default constructor).
